observations.title: Editor region navigation
observations.description: F6 and Shift+F6 move among top bar, canvas/slide and properties area; Tab and Escape handle the conversation/artifact boundary.
observations.acceptance: Test forward/backward navigation, focus restoration and nested edit mode.
observations.classification: official documentation or announcement; runtime untested

observations.title: Hierarchical canvas focus
observations.description: Enter/Return moves into selected artboards or nested groups; Tab navigates peers; Shift+Return moves up one level. Escape exits artboard then clears selection.
observations.acceptance: Test parent/child navigation, keyboard text editing and visible selection.
observations.classification: official documentation or announcement; runtime untested

observations.title: Selection toolbar conditional visibility
observations.description: A floating selection toolbar is available when properties panel is closed; F6 can reach it and arrows navigate its controls. Escape returns to the canvas preserving selection.
observations.acceptance: Test selection, inspector open/closed, arrow navigation and restored focus.
observations.classification: official documentation or announcement; runtime untested

observations.title: Scope-specific editing channel
observations.description: Comments target component changes; chat is used for broader structure; direct manipulation adjusts geometry and alignment.
observations.acceptance: Compare selected element, comment and broader request; do not infer exact pixel behavior.
observations.classification: official documentation or announcement; runtime untested

observations.title: Documented keyboard limitations
observations.description: Placing new design text, shapes, notes or artboards requires pointer input per guide. Noninteractive generated web artifacts may be skipped by Tab and may not scroll with arrows.
observations.acceptance: Verify keyboard-only creation and scroll fallback; do not label entire editor accessible.
observations.classification: official documentation or announcement; runtime untested

observations.title: Code-based motion artifact
observations.description: Motion animates existing content as code rather than generating realistic footage. Edit timing or content through chat or editor; export MP4.
observations.acceptance: Verify local change scope, playback, export and timing; no runtime measurement.
observations.classification: official documentation or announcement; runtime untested

observations.title: Design-system artifact and handoff
